comparison_policy: C1 changes the candidate universe from mixed 156 to labeled 105. A score difference versus an existing mixed-156 report is NOT an algorithm gain.

excluded_topics.relation_type: 机动车交通事故侵权责任法律关系

limitations: 10 of the original 13 fixed relation queries, evaluated on all 105 independently labeled LexRel cases; negative distractor candidates are retained.
This measures relation-type label retrieval, NOT case similarity or legal applicability.
Label absence means negative only under the supplied dataset's annotation definition.
Existing mixed-156 reports remain separate diagnostics; their scores are not interchangeable.
A rules remain complete; actual A/B/C and BM25 run offline without LLM, vector or Neo4j.
Facts-only text reduces metadata leakage but does not establish universal leakage freedom.
These repeatedly inspected questions are a development benchmark, not a blind test.

metric_definitions.empty_ranking: Recall and precision 0; returned-label coverage undefined (null)
metric_definitions.precision: relevant_retrieved / requested K, including unfilled slots
metric_definitions.qrel_presence_vs_label_coverage: Existing metrics.judged_returned counts explicit positive qrel entries only. relation_at_k measures independent source-label availability, including source-annotated records without the queried relation.
metric_definitions.recall_ceiling: min(K, positive_count) / positive_count; not normalized Recall
metric_definitions.unjudged_ratio: returned candidates without independent labels / returned candidates
